summary.purpose: Calculate Written and Unearned Premium for Homeowners (HO) and Auto (AU) insurance policies by reading policy master records and associated property, vehicle, and coverage data, applying product-specific rating formulas, and outputting premium records or error exceptions.
summary.high_level_narrative: The program initializes by opening six sequential files (four inputs, two outputs) and reading the first records from Property, Vehicle, and Coverage files. It then enters a main loop reading Policy records until EOF. For each policy, it determines product type (HO or AU). For HO, it searches Property file for matching policy number, then searches Coverage file for all coverages linked to that policy. If found, it calculates premium using Homeowners formula: Base + (Property Value * Risk Rate) + (Total Coverage Limits * Coverage Rate) - (Total Deductibles * Deductible Rate), applying minimum premium floor and maximum discount cap. For AU, it searches Vehicle file for matching policy, then Coverage file, and calculates using Auto formula: Base + (Vehicle Value * Risk Rate) + (Total Coverage Limits * Coverage Rate) - (Total Deductibles * Deductible Rate), with its own min/max constraints. Unearned premium is derived pro-rata based on days remaining in policy term. Successful calculations write to PREMIUM-OUT; missing data or invalid product types write to ERROR-OUT with specific error codes. Counters track reads, calculations, errors, and I/O errors for final reporting.
summary.business_domain: Insurance Premium Calculation / Personal Lines Rating Engine
key_transformations: Homeowners Premium = WS-HO-BASE + (PR-PROPERTY-VALUE * WS-HO-RISK-RATE) + (WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL * WS-HO-COV-RATE) - (WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL * WS-HO-DED-RATE)
Auto Premium = WS-AU-BASE + (VE-VEHICLE-VALUE * WS-AU-RISK-RATE) + (WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL * WS-AU-COV-RATE) - (WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL * WS-AU-DED-RATE)
Unearned Premium = Written Premium * (Days Remaining / Total Policy Days)
Earned Premium = Written Premium - Unearned Premium
Sequential file matching by Policy Number across Property, Vehicle, and Coverage files
business_rules: Product Type must be 'HO' (Homeowners) or 'AU' (Auto) - error P004 otherwise
Homeowners policy requires matching Property record - error P001 if missing
Auto policy requires matching Vehicle record - error P002 if missing
Both product types require at least one Coverage record - error P003 if missing
Homeowners Base Premium: 100.00, Risk Rate: 0.002, Coverage Rate: 0.001, Deductible Rate: 0.05
Auto Base Premium: 75.00, Risk Rate: 0.015, Coverage Rate: 0.0008, Deductible Rate: 0.03
Homeowners Minimum Premium: 150.00, Maximum Discount: 100.00
Auto Minimum Premium: 125.00, Maximum Discount: 75.00
Unearned premium calculated pro-rata using policy effective/expiry dates and current date
Premium ID generated as Policy Number + 'PRM' suffix

knowledge_profile.purpose: Calculate Written and Unearned Premium for Homeowners (HO) and Auto (AU) policies using risk-based rating formulas. Reads policy master, property, vehicle, and coverage files; matches records by policy number; applies product-specific rating algorithms with base rates, risk factors, coverage limits, and deductible discounts; outputs premium records and error exceptions.
key_logic: Initialize program: capture current date, open all input/output files
Prime-read PROPERTY-IN, VEHICLE-IN, COVERAGE-IN to load first records
Loop through POLICY-IN records until EOF or fatal error
For each policy: validate product type (HO or AU)
HOMEOWNERS path: find matching property record (by policy no), then find all coverage records for policy
AUTO path: find matching vehicle record (by policy no), then find all coverage records for policy
If required records missing, write error (P001: HO property not found, P002: AU vehicle not found, P003: no coverage, P004: invalid product type)

Calculate premium using product-specific formula: HO = Base + (PropertyValue * RiskRate) + (TotalCovLimit * CovRate) - (TotalDeductible * DedRate); AU = Base + (VehicleValue * RiskRate) + (TotalCovLimit * CovRate) - (TotalDeductible * DedRate)
Apply minimum premium floor and maximum discount cap
Compute earned/unearned premium based on policy dates and current date
Write premium record to PREMIUM-OUT
Close all files, display processing counters

transformations.description: Homeowners premium calculation: Base + (PropertyValue * RiskRate) + (TotalCovLimit * CovRate) - (TotalDeductible * DedRate)
transformations.expression: WS-HO-BASE + (PR-PROPERTY-VALUE * WS-HO-RISK-RATE) + (WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL * WS-HO-COV-RATE) - (WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL * WS-HO-DED-RATE)

transformations.description: Auto premium calculation: Base + (VehicleValue * RiskRate) + (TotalCovLimit * CovRate) - (TotalDeductible * DedRate)
transformations.expression: WS-AU-BASE + (VE-VEHICLE-VALUE * WS-AU-RISK-RATE) + (WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL * WS-AU-COV-RATE) - (WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL * WS-AU-DED-RATE)

transformations.description: Apply minimum premium floor: if calculated premium < product minimum, set to minimum
transformations.expression: IF WS-PREMIUM < WS-HO-MIN (for HO) OR WS-PREMIUM < WS-AU-MIN (for AU) THEN WS-PREMIUM = MIN

transformations.description: Apply maximum discount cap: if deductible discount > product max discount, cap at max
transformations.expression: IF WS-DISCOUNT > WS-HO-MAX-DISC (HO) OR WS-DISCOUNT > WS-AU-MAX-DISC (AU) THEN WS-DISCOUNT = MAX-DISC

transformations.description: Sum coverage limits and deductibles across all coverage records for a policy
transformations.expression: WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL = SUM(CO-COVERAGE-LIMIT); WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL = SUM(CO-DEDUCTIBLE); WS-COVERAGE-COUNT = COUNT(*)

business_rules: Product type must be 'HO' (Homeowners) or 'AU' (Auto); any other value triggers error P004
Homeowners policies require a matching property record (by policy number); missing triggers error P001
Auto policies require a matching vehicle record (by policy number); missing triggers error P002
Both product types require at least one coverage record; missing triggers error P003
HO Premium Formula: 100.00 + (PropertyValue * 0.002) + (TotalCoverageLimit * 0.001) - (TotalDeductible * 0.05)
AU Premium Formula: 75.00 + (VehicleValue * 0.015) + (TotalCoverageLimit * 0.0008) - (TotalDeductible * 0.03)
Minimum premium: HO = 150.00, AU = 125.00
Maximum deductible discount: HO = 100.00, AU = 75.00
All input files are sequential and must be pre-sorted by policy number for matching logic to work
Current date captured at program start used for calculation date and earned/unearned proration
File status '00' required for all I/O operations; non-zero triggers fatal error
